name: litmine_mva_exposures.tsv
code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands this file

extractor.method: read the screened sentences (build/it5/transfer/r3/reading/*.md) with their context and wrote each row by hand, copying the quote from the cached text

gate: mva.drugs.litmine_verify.verify_rows: NFKC + quote/dash folding + whitespace collapse, case kept, min 30 characters, verbatim substring of the cached text of the cited PMID; a failing row is rejected, never repaired

sources.clinical: hpo_overlap names the child's HPO terms from ressources/hackathon-rules/Challenge_Clinical_Phenotype_1.md

limitations: the reader saw screened sentences, not whole papers; a verified quote proves the sentence exists, not that the row reads it correctly
